decisive_items: Initial blood culture from tunneled catheter: positive at 7.2 hours
Gram stain from all three sets showed gram-negative bacilli
receiving milrinone at home through a double lumen tunneled catheter
response.rationale: R4C precisely identifies gram-negative bacteremia sourced from the tunneled catheter, supported by differential culture times and gram stain. R1 is broader (CRBSI) without specifying organism; other candidates lack the definitive microbiologic evidence or contradict stability/imaging.

rejected.why: Heart failure signs present but not the acute infectious diagnosis; no bacteremia link.
Pneumonia contradicted by chest radiograph showing no consolidation.
Septic shock contradicted by hemodynamically stable status.
Correct category but less specific than R4C; lacks gram-negative etiology.
Sepsis is too broad and contradicted by initial afebrile status; no source specified.
